results.reason: This study examines a virtual reality exposure therapy platform for OCD, which is directly relevant to clinical psychology practice, specifically for therapists treating obsessive-compulsive disorder using exposure and response prevention (ERP).

results.title: Sound Relief: Restorative Music as a Strategy to Improve Clinician Well-being
results.reason: The paper directly addresses clinician well-being and burnout, which are critical issues in clinical psychology practice. It investigates a music-based intervention that has implications for mental health professionals working in high-stress environments.
results.authors: Nicole Salehi; Clara Takarabe; Macy Walesa; Logan Pause; Gaurava Agarwal; Borna Bonakdarpour

results.title: An in-school mindfulness-based intervention for underserved youth: Exploring str
results.reason: The paper examines a school-based mindfulness intervention for underserved youth, focusing on stress, anxiety, and emotional well-being - all directly relevant to clinical psychology practice with vulnerable populations.
results.authors: Brianna Paquette; Melanie Grace Albright; Heather Austin; Sylvie Mrug; Caroline G. Richter

results.title: Work-focused cognitive behavioural therapy for common mental disorders: a system
results.reason: This systematic review and meta-analysis examines work-focused cognitive behavioral therapy (W-CBT) for common mental disorders, which has direct clinical relevance for treating working adults with depression, anxiety, and stress-related disorders. The study evaluates both psychiatric symptoms and return-to-work outcomes, providing important evidence for clinical practice.
results.authors: Anna Finnes; Magnus Johansson; Robin Bernhardtz; Lars-Göran Öst

results.title: Digital Delusion: A Mixed Methods Exploration of AI Psychosis in Reddit Posts
results.reason: The paper examines AI-related psychiatric phenomena, which has direct clinical relevance for psychiatrists and psychologists working with patients experiencing psychosis or digital distress. It explores a novel clinical presentation in the digital age.
results.authors: Nam Tran; Brianna Papoutsis; Mariana Ortiz; Angela Tran; Vincent Zhao; Nicole Neifert; Madeline Barrett; Stephanie Ko; Himani Devabhaktuni; Benjamin Nguyen
